funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any career stage (up to £8,000) or postdoctoral/equivalent and above (£8,001-£20,000); open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible grants for individuals undertaking research travel and/or taking time to address specific research questions in British art, visual culture and/or architecture.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Small, up to £2,000; Large, from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any career stage; applicant must be the author or editor of the proposed publication, with a publisher confirmed and publication date within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to disseminate research on British art through publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals enrolled to start (with a place confirmed) or already undertaking a master's level or doctoral level degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Fixed £5,000 grant for students facing barriers to begin or continue a master's or doctoral degree in the field of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country.
opportunities.summary: £2,000 grants for registered students to undertake research trips to examine historical British works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: £32,000 total for one year, or split over two years for part-time study

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a master's degree place at a UK-based institution, due to begin between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) in British art, part of the New Narratives scheme to bring new perspectives to the field.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: £96,000 total, awarded as £32,000 a year for three years (or split over further years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a doctorate degree place at a UK-based institution, due to begin between April 2027 and April 2028. Open to international applicants who do not qualify for home fees.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a doctorate in British art, paying university fees with the remainder for living expenses, part of the New Narratives scheme to expand perspectives in the field.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 for one year, or £70,000 for two years (£35,000 per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at postdoctoral level (or with equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Fellowship to undertake a major in-depth research project in the field of British art that will reshape understanding of the field.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: Full board and accommodation at the British School at Rome for three months, plus an honorarium

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre-doctoral PhD candidates to those internationally recognised in their field.
opportunities.summary: A three-month residency at the British School at Rome for individuals undertaking advanced research on a British-Italian topic relating to cultural contact, exchange and influence between Britain and Italy.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed. Organisations can apply for only one Research Project Grant per round.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research projects in the field of British art, primarily supporting staff costs towards research with public-facing outcomes and/or legacy.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; the exhibition on which the publication is based can be forthcoming or already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting the costs of producing publications related to exhibitions and displays that showcase new and original research on British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting the dissemination of research on British art through live, online and hybrid events put on by an organisation for a variety of audiences.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking a conservation research project or technical analysis leading to a research project. Items must be in public or charitable ownership and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Grants to help protect and preserve significant works of British art by funding organisations to undertake original and needed conservation research.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking work to digitise items and material in their own collections relating to British art.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting organisations to make their collections freely available to audiences online via digitisation of photographic, archival, bound volumes, objects, paintings, publications or other assets.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Travel Bursaries (ERBA)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Members of Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA); applications with pending membership are also welcome.
opportunities.summary: Research Travel Bursaries of up to £250 for ERBA Members to support a specific research trip, such as visiting a library, archive, collection or site, or travelling to meet a key contact or attend a research-related event.
